title: Character Frequency Counter
h1: Character Frequency Counter — Count Characters in Text
seoTitle: Character Frequency Counter — Free Online Text Tool
description: Count how often each character appears in any text. See frequencies for letters, numbers, spaces and punctuation. Private and instant in your browser.
intro: Paste any text to see a sorted list of every character and how many times it appears. Useful for analysis, puzzles and data cleaning.
blurb: Count the frequency of every character in a block of text.
howItWorks: Paste or type the text you want to analyse.
Click Count characters to generate the frequency list.
See every unique character sorted by count, plus totals for letters, spaces and more.
examples: Analyse the letter frequencies in a passage for a cipher or puzzle.
Check how many spaces or punctuation marks are in a document draft.
Count specific characters while cleaning or normalising text.

faq.q: Does it count spaces and punctuation?
faq.a: Yes. Every character including spaces, tabs, newlines, letters, digits and symbols is counted separately.
Yes. Uppercase and lowercase letters are treated as different characters.
No. Counting happens entirely in your browser. The text never leaves your device.
